title: 彭博航天主编：SpaceX IPO定价策略——低预期再超预期
speaker: Benedict Campbell

segments.en: The these numbers are pretty you know bonkers if you look at them they came out with the listing a week ago and that's really where they pull the cut and back on sort of a lot of the numbers and they are really out there so I think what we are seeing now is the managing banks going to investors getting a feel from the market.
segments.zh: 这些数字相当惊人，一周前他们公布上市计划，并大幅调整了数字。我认为现在看到的是承销银行接触投资者，试探市场情绪。

segments.en: What is the demand out there and what they'll be seeing is that they're low bowling it you know that you've come you're coming in you're managing expectations and maybe you're coming in with a slightly lower expectation and then you blow that out of the water so that might well be what's going on right now you don't want to over promise and then under liver probably you want to go the other way so that might well be where we are right now who knows where it'll settle will find out in the next couple of days.
segments.zh: 他们正在压低预期，先给出略低的目标，然后大幅超越。这样避免过度承诺而交付不足，很可能就是当前策略。最终定价将在未来几天揭晓。
